subject: SIG: incident notification latency mapping & on-call handshake
messages:
From: Alex Turner <security@greenwave.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@greenwave.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — clarification on notification windows and evidence format

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for sending the SIG questionnaire. A quick follow-up from our security review: we need to confirm Redwood's practical notification and evidence-delivery expectations for incidents that may impact customer data. Specifically: 

- What is your initial acknowledgment SLA for confirmed critical incidents (we typically ask for an "ack" within 4 hours)?
- When do you typically provide a "formal notification" to customers (we've seen policies range from 24–72 hours)?
- Do you have a canonical on-call mapping (names/roles/24x7?) we can reference for escalation?
- For forensic needs, what log exports can you deliver (fields, redaction approach, max retention slices)?
- Preferred secure channel for transferring redacted logs (SFTP, secure Drive link, or direct AWS S3 presigned upload)?

If you can attach a brief one-page timeline example (redacted) and a contacts CSV, that would help us close our SIG evidence section. We can also sign an acknowledgment form if needed.

Appreciate a short reply for our compliance team — we're aiming to finalize the SIG answers by Friday.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of InfoSec
GreenWave Inc.
security@greenwave.com

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <security@greenwave.com>
Cc: samir.patel@greenwave.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — clarification on notification windows and evidence format

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Summary of our practical commitments and what I can attach now:

- Initial acknowledgement: for incidents classified as Critical we acknowledge within 4 hours of detection; for High/Medium we acknowledge within 24 hours.
- Notification cadence: we provide a status update within 24 hours and a formal customer notification within 72 hours when customer-impacting exposure is confirmed.
- On-call mapping: we maintain a 24x7 IR roster. I've attached a redacted contacts CSV (redwood-irc-contacts.csv) that lists roles (IR lead, on-call SRE, legal POC). For privacy reasons we list role handles and escalation group emails rather than personal mobile numbers.
- Evidence/logs: we can provide redacted log slices covering the event window (timestamps, request IDs, source IPs, user identifiers hashed). We redact sensitive identifiers by default; if GreenWave needs wider fields we can agree on a redaction spec prior to transfer. I've included a short redacted sample (redacted-network-log-sample.txt).
- Transfer channel: preferred is SFTP with client-managed keys or presigned S3 URLs behind a dedicated envelope. We can also provide a secure Drive folder if you prefer.

Attachments I'm sending now: SIG-notify-summary.pdf (one-page process summary), redwood-irc-contacts.csv, redacted-network-log-sample.txt.

Next steps: please confirm whether SFTP or presigned S3 is preferred. If you want us to sign an acknowledgement form, send it over and we will return a countersigned copy within one business day.

Cc'ing Aditya (legal/comms) and Mina (security operations) to keep them in the loop for any redlines.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

[Attachments: SIG-notify-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-irc-contacts.csv (csv), redacted-network-log-sample.txt (txt)]

Thanks — quick internal note before we finalize the SIG answers:

- Legal would prefer the "formal notification within 72 hours" language to read "up to 72 hours following confirmation of unauthorized access to customer data" to avoid implying we notify before verification.
- Ops requests that the SFTP workflow include an agreed retention window for transferred artifacts (we suggest 30 days default unless otherwise negotiated).

Alex, if that wording looks good to you we'll include it in the SIG response. Also confirming we'll send a countersigned acknowledgement form if you provide one; otherwise we'll attach our standard IR statement.
